question: The United Nations designates _______ as the 'International Year of Micro Credit'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Nations Headquarters (Secretariat) is located in New York__
 
• The United Nations was formed following the devastating World War II.
 __
 
• It was established with the aim of preventing future global-scale conflicts.
 
• The representatives of 50 governments met in San Francisco on 25 April 1945, to draft what became the UN Charter.
 
• The Charter was adopted on 25 June 1945 and came into effect on 24 October 1945.
 
 
 
• United Nations Functions
 
 
• ​In accordance with the Charter, the organization’s objectives include maintaining international peace and security, protecting human rights, delivering humanitarian aid, promoting sustainable development, and upholding international law.
 
• At its founding, the UN had 51 member states. It grew to 193 in 2011, representing the vast majority of the world’s sovereign states.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The General Assembly occupies a central position as the chief deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ of the United Nations.
